title: Marketing > Teams: Reset password per person, workspace link, and email the reset link
text: On the CRM's Marketing > Teams page, each person in the People table (Rocco included) now has a Reset password button. It makes a one-time link that works once and expires in 24 hours; copy it, or email it to that login's own address after seeing the exact email and pressing Send now. The page also shows the permanent workspace link with a Copy button.
points: On the workspace Team page (Rocco's screen) the reset button no longer appears on a team owner's row; Antonio makes an owner's link from Marketing > Teams.
A team member who is a CRM admin now shows as Owner instead of Team owner.
